newsitems.title: Terraria State of the Game - August 2026
newsitems.author: Loki ISP
newsitems.contents:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3949769/87b096d573c175653a3b7b3c2342b9e60fa63c4f.png[/img]

Greetings Terrarians!
​
So, 1.4.5.7 is out for PC, coming very soon for Console and Mobile - how exciting!  We hope you all enjoy what is on offer with this latest Terraria update.  The next few steps in our journey are pretty exciting, and we cannot wait to share all of that with you in the months ahead.  For now, we have left a few hints in this month's developer update sections.  We are currently on the road at Gamescom with the majority of Team Terraria and that has been equal parts productive and ridiculously fun.  We will share more about our travels later on.  All that said, let's cover what has been going on over the past month and a tease for what lies ahead, shall we?

On with the show!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3949769/0fafbfc560bf0a25fbfca5b645c7c5e3f66ac51b.png[/img]

[h1][b]PC - RE-LOGIC[/b][/h1]

[h2][b]TERRARIA 1.4.5.7 - RELEASED LAST WEEK FOR PC[/b][/h2]

We hope that everyone has been enjoying what Terraria 1.4.5.7 has to offer over the past week or so. As we mentioned previously, we will be watching feedback closely to see what tweaks might need to be made in addition to a few other tidbits that we still want to address in future updates. In case you missed it for some reason, the link to the changelog thread is below.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/105600/view/692018222142062720][u][h3][b]TERRARIA 1.4.5.7 CHANGELOG[/b][/h3][/u][/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3949769/0fafbfc560bf0a25fbfca5b645c7c5e3f66ac51b.png[/img]

[h2][b]CROSSPLAY IS ON DECK![/b][/h2]

Once 1.4.5.7 is out for Console and Mobile and we have a few days to ensure all is well and stable, we will be pushing directly into Terraria 1.4.6, which will be Phase One of Crossplay! There may be some other minor things within that update as well, but Crossplay is the name of the game. In case you need a refresher about how Terraria Crossplay will roll out - namely, in two distinct phases - we have included a link to that summary from DR Studios below:

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/105600/view/519739684971085956][u][h3][b]CROSSPLAY ROLLOUT PLAN - FROM FEBRUARY 2026 STATE OF THE GAME[/b][/h3][/u][/url]

We cannot wait for Terraria to enter the Crossplay era at long last! Stay tuned for updates on that journey soon.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3949769/0fafbfc560bf0a25fbfca5b645c7c5e3f66ac51b.png[/img]

[h2][b]WHAT COMES NEXT? PLANNING THE PATH AHEAD AT GAMESCOM[/b][/h2]

The Re-Logic and DR Studios teams met this week at Gamescom in Cologne, Germany for a few days of planning sessions, idea development, team building and more. This is the first time that both teams have been able to connect in person since prior to COVID.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3949769/059e0edf388379f7d5e8ef92e94a8cab80eb7f39.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3949769/b6b3e773fbd6c9a057e5e6bf04cce1e28a8cecb5.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3949769/b97b8186d6ae328dba0b42a6d13716bbfc32ade8.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3949769/f7044cd2ff63af786b74a783a2ca873f5eb9923b.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3949769/5492e86ecc42e09591e524a4c607e7bbf2be4b2f.png[/img]
[i]Out and about at Gamescom[/i]

We went over all sorts of topics, from how we can better work together to ideas for future Terraria updates and beyond. The results of that planning will all come together in a couple of weeks once we can go over notes and turn that into what might fit best into each future update. We will be sharing at least some of the big picture in regards to how everything will operate going ahead in the near future. You will definitely want to stay tuned for that!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3949769/62f2660c4680b1dbaf77a16d19e8246f8635ac33.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3949769/1fef5058004cf5b6585feff4078a087715886fe9.jpg[/img]
[i]Team Terraria![/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3949769/0fafbfc560bf0a25fbfca5b645c7c5e3f66ac51b.png[/img]

[h1][b]TMODLOADER NEWS - TML TEAM[/b][/h1]
[img src="https://i.imgur.com/oLHogOc.png"][/img]

Hello everyone!

On September 1st, the regular monthly update release of tModLoader for 1.4.4 will go live. Some notable features include enabling 'content descriptors' on Steam Workshop and a simplified API for adding flails in mods.

As mentioned previously, the tModLoader team has been spending most of our efforts working on updating tModLoader to the latest Terraria 1.4.5 update - including 1.4.5.8. We are continuing to see a huge amount of community participation and contributions for the 1.4.5 update and are extremely grateful for those willing to help with this process through code contributions, bug reporting, testing, and participating in the discussions that take place on Discord. The tModLoader team will continue to work with experienced modders to progress towards the tModLoader 1.4.5 release.

This process as well as any other big changes desired by the modding community for this update will take many months still. There are still many tasks to be done, if you are interested in contributing code for the 1.4.5 update, the [url=https://github.com/tModLoader/tModLoader/issues/5070]1.4.5 Update Information page[/url] has information on how to contribute and what tasks remain to be done. That page also explains how to join the "1.4.5-dev" beta branch on Steam to test out the current state of the update. Users can join that beta branch to help identify and report remaining bugs.

Modders and users should also keep an eye out for our monthly Steam announcement on the 1st where a complete listing of bug fixes and API changes for this month's release will be listed. The in-game news button on the main menu will direct you directly to the announcement once it is live.

We look forward to seeing how mods make use of these new features.  As always, if you are having issues of any sort, definitely don't hesitate to check out our [url="https://github.com/tModLoader/tModLoader/wiki/Basic-tModLoader-Usage-FAQ"]FAQ on github[/url] or reach out to us at our [url="https://discord.com/invite/tmodloader"]Discord[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3949769/3c24853f896391bff2d39309d74b489d2394da30.png[/img]

[h2][b]TMODLOADER STEAM WORKSHOP[/b][/h2][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3949769/7a27011270895daaf45499c6c7a0663d3e586410.png"][/img]The TML Steam Workshop has over 10,000 mods for you to enjoy! Coupled with the in-game mod browser, the TML Steam Workshop is a great way to explore what modded Terraria has to offer - check it out today by clicking the banner above!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3949769/0fafbfc560bf0a25fbfca5b645c7c5e3f66ac51b.png[/img]

[h1][b]PlayStation, XBOX, Nintendo Switch, Mobile - DR STUDIOS[/b][/h1]

Hello Terrarians!

As you know by now, Terraria 1.4.5.7 released for PC about a week ago.  In parallel, we have prepared the Console and Mobile builds for submission and that process is underway.  Once we hear back from the various first parties, we will be able to bring the latest Terraria update to everyone else.  The intent was to make this a simultaneous update, but that just wasn't feasible this time due to the travel and such.  Speaking of, the joint planning session with Re-Logic this week was amazing, helping to set the future of Terraria in place.

So, no spoilers this month - just an update that 1.4.5.7 (and 1.4.5.8) is coming very soon and this week was a great one!

---

Until next time, Console & Mobile friends - thanks for all of your love and support!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3949769/0fafbfc560bf0a25fbfca5b645c7c5e3f66ac51b.png[/img]

[h1][b]COMMUNITY[/b][/h1]
Greetings Terrarians!

Here's the latest and greatest happenings on the Community side of things. Thanks as always for being the most engaged and awesome gaming Community ever!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3949769/3c24853f896391bff2d39309d74b489d2394da30.png[/img]

[h2][b]TERRARIA MERCHANDISE HUB​[/b][/h2]
The Terraria merchandise hub is where you can find all of the latest and greatest Terraria merchandise all year round - with new stuff arriving all of the time! Check out the latest merch drops as well as some classics and pick up that epic Terraria gift for a friend (or yourself!).

[img src="https://i.imgur.com/VaZ73gn.png"][/img]Click the banner above to head to [url="http://terraria.org/store"]Terraria.org/store[/url] now!​

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3949769/0fafbfc560bf0a25fbfca5b645c7c5e3f66ac51b.png[/img]

[h2][b]TERRARIA MERCHANDISE UPDATES​[/b][/h2]

[h3][b]TERRARIA 15TH ANNIVERSARY COLLECTOR'S EDITION - PREORDERS OPEN UNTIL 8/31[/b][/h3]

[url=https://terraria.shop/products/terraria-collectors-edition][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3949769/543b9c7c71ae35d9e45e9872a4d27263d125d073.png[/img][/url]

We are rapidly nearing the end of the road for preorders for the Terraria Collector's Edition! Now is the time to get yours in if you want to secure one of these for yourself. There is a good chance that we will have some extras due to how these have to be ordered, but once those are sold out, that's it!

(We have had some discussions around if we should make SOMETHING available more long term - but let us know what you think?)

Check out the details by clicking the banner above!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3949769/0fafbfc560bf0a25fbfca5b645c7c5e3f66ac51b.png[/img]

[h3][b]TERRARIA COLLECTION FROM STEADY HANDS - OUT NOW![/b][/h3]

The latest partner in the world of Terraria - Steady Hands - released their initial collection last week, and there is a lot here! If you are not familiar with Steady Hands, they are a small, independent clothing brand with a focus on cut and sew clothing and designs. This results in some pretty unique designs and product types (sweaters and cardigans anyone?) that we have not had previously. Check out the full collection by clicking the banner below and pick up anything that catches your eye today!

[url=https://www.steady-hands.com/collections/terraria][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3949769/9b88fb38c414269e8ed78f85130ce2e078870392.png[/img][/url]

We love to browse Terraria associated social pages and check out the creative minds sharing wonderful creations. [h3][b]TERRARIA TRIVIA STAGE CONTEST[/b][/h3]

The monthly trivia stage contest can always crown some new winners however. So be sure to join the [url=https://discord.com/invite/terraria]Official Terraria Discord[/url] to find the latest event details & join in next month!

[h3][b]CROSS THE WORLD SPEEDRUN​[/b][/h3]

And to kick off the launch of 1.4.5.7, another event is ongoing! This speedrun contest is all about going from one world border to another on the Celebration MK10 special seed! newsitems.title: Terraria: Design Works - Preorder yours today!
newsitems.author: Loki ISP
newsitems.contents:
[h1][b]TERRARIA: DESIGN WORKS[/b][/h1]

[url=https://lostincult.co.uk/terraria][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3949769/a976cf93cd75c042c57fa321a461b61cb024aa44.jpg[/img][/url]

This premium book will chart the design and development of Terraria from its inception back in 2011 through to today, written by Christian Donlan.

Now you can dig into the game’s development itself with Terraria: Design Works. Based on in-depth interviews with Andrew Spinks, the singular individual who created Terraria, along with the fascinating team who have worked with him to keep the game thriving for the last fifteen years, this is the story of a game developed with passion, ingenuity, imagination and generosity.

It’s easy to lose yourself in Terraria when playing, and now you’ll discover the challenges of charting a development course through such a rich, sprawling, and surprising game. You’ll meet the people who have worked with Spinks to evolve his original design, and you’ll come to understand where many of Terraria’s legendary elements come from, whether that’s a biome, an end-game monster or just a really cool sword!

Packed with behind the scene insights, developer interviews and never seen before content, the book is available standalone or as part of a Deluxe Edition complete with a treasure trove of Terraria goodies.


Pre-order now via the link below or by clicking the banner above!

[url=https://lostincult.co.uk/terraria]Terraria: Design Works — Lost In Cult[/url]

DELUXE EDITION[/b][/h1]

Alongside the luxurious slipcase, you’ll discover a treasure trove of collectible items to unearth, all housed in a premium deluxe presentation box, perfect for keeping your treasures safe from prying eyes (or eye, for that matter…)

[list]
[*] [b]Bestiary Blitz card game[/b]: this quick play card game is designed around the enemies and bosses found in the world of Terraria! Each card in Bestiary Blitz features a Terraria enemy or boss, a bestiary entry description, and includes key performance categories with assigned values. Compare statistics of Terraria monsters to determine a winner for each round, with the ultimate goal of collecting all the cards from your opponents!
[*] [b]A bespoke papercraft kit[/b]: bring your very own piece of Terraria to life step by step when you assemble this paper theatre, featuring brand new pixel art - perfect for adorning the shelf of any fan.

[*] [b]A holo bookmark[/b]: the double sided bookmark is decorated with pixel sprites of some of Terraria’s most beloved furry friends, printed on rainbow effect holographic paper to match the pixel art poster!
[*] [b]Nine postcards[/b]: featuring some of Terraria’s most beloved biomes, these postcards are the perfect artifact for true fans, allowing you to take one step closer to its rich worlds.

newsitems.title: Terraria 15th Anniversary Collector's Edition - Preorders are now open!
newsitems.author: Loki ISP
newsitems.contents:
[url=https://terraria.shop/products/terraria-collectors-edition][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3949769/4fb7256abf386d0b442240450d42d5a3548af554.png[/img][/url]

Greetings, Terrarians!

As we mentioned in our 15th Anniversary post a few weeks ago, we are beyond excited to roll out a brand new Terraria Collector's Edition. We think this is a nice handful of really cool collectables that the fans will enjoy. Anyway, let's jump right in to the details, shall we?

[previewyoutube=fWWgbxsSmO8;full][/previewyoutube]
Check out a quick video preview of the Terraria 15th Anniversary Collector's Edition!

So, what all is included?

[h3][b]TERRARIAN HERO FIGURINE[/b][/h3]
Recreating Terraria’s iconic box art, this stunning figurine diorama stands just over 6 inches tall. This proud Terrarian hero strides forth into the depths in search of adventure, fortune, and certain death!

---

[h3][b]LIFE CRYSTAL[/b][/h3]
Ahh, the hours spent digging around for these little beauties. Permanently level up your life with your very own Life Crystal! Suspended on a removable stand, this hefty heart is the perfect keepsake for any desk or shelf.

---
[h3][b]
LENTICULAR PIXEL ART CARD SET[/b][/h3]
Exquisite pixel art collectible cards with lenticular animation.

---
[h3][b]
RE-GAME CARTRIDGE[/b][/h3]
“And now for something completely different.”
Immortalise your own copy of Terraria with this awesome retro replica. This replica game cartridge houses a beautifully detailed Terraria game token, upon which a Steam key for Terraria will be engraved. The ultimate collectible and display piece for your favourite game.

---

[h3][b]LETTER FROM RED[/b][/h3]
To cap things off, we have a lovely little letter from Terraria’s legendary creator, Andrew Spinks, a.k.a. Redigit. The letter is adorned with gold foil edges and a Terraria logo seal. Yours to cherish.

---

Of course, no Terraria Collector's Edition would be complete without the Bunny Pet, so that will be included as well.


We have really enjoyed working on this project with the fine folks over at GLO (the terraria.shop people) and we hope that you find the final package to be as cool as we do. If you want to learn more or place your preorder, simply click the link below or the banner image at the top of this post.

[url=https://terraria.shop/products/terraria-collectors-edition][h2][u][b]TERRARIA 15TH ANNIVERSARY COLLECTOR'S EDITION[/b][/u][/h2][/url]

Thanks for an amazing 15 years!!!​
